title: QOM, Oct 18 - Abbas Ka'bi, member of the Presidium of the Assembly of Experts made remarks in an interview.
text:
QOM, Oct 18 - Abbas Ka'bi, member of the Presidium of the Assembly of Experts made remarks in an interview."

"———-"

"SOT1, Abbas Ka'bi, member of the Presidium of the Assembly of Experts (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:52): “Continues Generating power to end the state of no war no peace and utilizing the country's capacity and the capacity of 32 million self-sacrificed  by dividing to dedicate work for them to explain the role of civilized organizations and the generation of power in all sectors of the country: cultural power, economic power, social power, political power, security power, defensive power, and military power.”"

""
"SOT2, Abbas Ka'bi, member of the Presidium of the Assembly of Experts (Farsi) (00:53 - 01:47): “Through continuous production of power, converting weaknesses into strengths and threats into opportunities, maintaining cohesion and the structural integrity of the country, and implementing the directives of the Supreme Leader and the Commander-in-Chief, Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei, the strategy is: legitimate self-defense, the punishment of the aggressor, the end of the state of no war no peace, the recovery of losses and reparations, and vengeance against the international criminals Trump and Netanyahu.”
